datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across Kenya. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled for medium-term projections at three time points in 2017 (February, June, October) and distributed in GeoJSON and KML formats.
